$comment: Parties and ledger users created by bootstrap.mjs. Each org party gets one least-privilege user (CanActAs + CanReadAs its own party, plus readAs extras). `participant` is used only in 3-participant mode; in 1-participant mode every party lives on `sandbox`. Party ids are generated by Canton and change on every sandbox start: read them from .local/localnet/state.json, never hard-code them.

dars.$extraComment: Uploaded in addition to the built DARs: DM governance-core-v1 provides GovernanceRules (daml-model.md section 1); it is not a build dependency of the contracts DAR.
